name: voiceapi
description: Clone voices from dropped audio, speak with them, transcribe and clean speech through a self-hosted voiceapi.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a recording into a custom voice, then speak with it
interface.longDescription: Uploads local audio (for example a file dropped into the Ovis chat) to a self-hosted voiceapi gateway, which cleans it with NVIDIA RE-USE, transcribes it with Qwen3-ASR and builds a Qwen3-TTS clone voice. Also synthesizes speech to local files, transcribes, and cleans audio.
defaultPrompt: Turn the file I just dropped into a custom voice called Narrator.
Say "hello there" with my Narrator voice.
